entities.name: Zheng He's Treasure Fleet
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Admiral Zheng He commanded fleets of 300+ ships — the largest wooden vessels ever built (400 feet long). Seven voyages reached Africa, Arabia, and Southeast Asia. Then China turned inward and burned the fleet.
